models.name: new-dash
models.note: Designed from Car Kit parts. Dash, the all-rounder: a hot-rod roadster, long bonnet and upright grille, small front wheels on an exposed axle, big rear ones.

models.name: new-bolt
models.note: Designed from Car Kit parts. Bolt, the fastest and lightest: a Seven-style roadster, long nose, cycle fenders over the front wheels, a headrest fairing, side pipes.

models.name: new-carve
models.note: Designed from Car Kit parts. Carve, the corner king: a short dune buggy, wheels at the corners under open flares, a roll bar and the engine out the back.

models.name: new-rumble
models.note: Designed from Car Kit parts. Rumble, the heavy one: an open 4x4 on truck tyres, bull bar, roll cage with a light bar, the spare on its tail.

models.name: remix-dash
models.note: Dash, the roster's low racer: Car Kit wheels, light glass, block head and tail lamps, a grille.

models.name: remix-bolt
models.note: Bolt, the roster's open-wheel speedster: Car Kit racing wheels, nose lamps, tail lamps on a bar.

models.name: remix-carve
models.note: Carve, the roster's racer: Car Kit racing wheels, light glass, block head and tail lamps, a grille.

models.name: remix-rumble
models.note: Rumble, the roster's vintage racer: Car Kit wheels, block lamps beside a grille, tail lamps.

models.name: remodel-dash
models.note: Dash remodelled: side windows, a bonnet scoop, the spoiler raised on struts, side skirts, block lamps and a grille.

models.name: remodel-bolt
models.note: Bolt remodelled: a tall airbox behind the cockpit, side pods with dark intakes, nose lamps, tail lamps on a bar.

models.name: remodel-carve
models.note: Carve remodelled as a rally car: side windows, a roof light pod and roof scoop, a dark bonnet vent, block lamps and a grille.

models.name: remodel-rumble
models.note: Rumble remodelled: the purple carried over the bonnet, a tall chrome grille, big block headlamps, tail lamps.
